body:
I'll start by examining the current files and the reference style.

All four chapters revised and verified.

## Final sizes (`wc -c`)

| File | Bytes | Sections | Sections→`## Sources` last |
|---|---|---|---|
| `07-security-and-keys.md` | **7,037** | 7 | ✓ |
| `08-providers-and-routing.md` | **7,061** | 7 | ✓ |
| `09-api-usage.md` | **7,077** | 8 | ✓ |
| `10-budgets-and-spend.md` | **7,181** | 5 | ✓ |

All in 6,200–7,200; every file starts `# NN — Title`, English, one `## Sources` (≤5–6 bullets, deduped). Every `path:line` was re-resolved against `/tmp/litellm-src` (bcb1f486): no missing files, no out-of-range lines.

## Structural changes
- **07:** merged master-key sourcing + boot refusal; merged inheritance (§4) with model-access resolution, dropping the duplicated standalone-model-inheritance sentence; SSO/JWT boundary kept intact incl. advisory lock, billable-user exclusion, `403` without license, `PremiumRequired::Jwt`.
- **08:** merged health checks with the Redis section; dropped the "practical defaults" section (all three facts survive in §1/§5/§6); strategy table thinned to Picks/Notes.
- **09:** route table lost its per-row source column, consolidated into one citation paragraph; removed the Responses and embeddings curl blocks and the Python SDK block (behavior kept: `input` vs `messages`, `data[].embedding`+`usage`, `base_url`/`baseKey`); kept the chat curl as the only recipe.
- **10:** collapsed the standalone "database rule" section into the scope line; merged reservation + fail-closed; merged spend logs + cost calculation; scope table retains all 11 scopes.

## Wrong citations fixed (they resolved but pointed at unrelated lines)
- `key_requests.py:150-157` → `:160` (grace_period)
- `key_management_endpoints.py:4178-4180` → `:4193` (`soft_budget` "warning vs. hard stop")
- `:4174-4176` → `:4185,4187` (`tags`, `enforced_params` Enterprise)
- deleted-key archive `:5176-5200,8217-8232` → `:5197,5965-5974` (`deleted_at`/`deleted_by`)
- Added `:113-117,139-140` alongside the boot-check ranges actually read; dropped `types/router.py:825-834,909-912` (unused).

## Deliberately dropped
- 07: per-route line numbers for the eight `/key/*` lifecycle routes (prose list + file path retains discoverability).
- 08: `usage-based-routing-v2`'s "respects per-deployment limits" clause and the standalone operational-defaults section; four Sources URLs (configs, health, redis, providers) remain as inline citations.
- 09: two curl blocks and the Python SDK snippet, as above; `x-litellm-call-id`-on-errors tip kept.
- 10: `model_cost_map.md` and `error_reference.md` from Sources (both still inline-cited), and repo-path line ranges in the Sources bullet (kept inline in body).
